title: Research again looks only at what failed, is old or was never tried; each network's social search is a part of its own with a stricter, wider search
steps: S1: work out the Research again plan of rows that failed an hour ago, are 31 days old, say the place has nothing, have an old rule version, were never tried, or cannot run here; then the same with a cost cap.
S2: match a page one letter off the place's name with and without the branch phone, a two-letters-off name, a page saying it is temporarily closed; search a place whose first query finds nothing.
S3: research a place with no website; delete its search rows (a place researched before the search existed) and press Research again; press again when nothing is due; press while a run is queued.
S4: Try again one network's search that finds nothing new.
S5: an account presses with its daily limit at 0, then within it; a stranger on /find presses twice, after the run, and with the public budget spent.
S6: /ops confirms a page the search left pending, and a url the search never found.
S7: read Google Place Details facts with a phone and an address.
expect: S1: run reasons failed, outdated, rule-changed, never with each part's ceiling; kept none, up-to-date, unavailable; the cap drops the dearest part as over-cap.

S2: one letter off + full branch phone → confirmed with name_near; without proof → pending; two letters off → rejected; closed page → pending page_closed; the phone query runs second and finds the page.

S3: facebook-search/instagram-search rows with the social-search rule version; Research again runs only the two searches (Google Place Details not fetched again) and leaves nothing due; nothing due queues nothing; a press during a queued run joins it.
S4: only the Instagram search runs and the try's time is on the current research.

S5: RESEARCH_AGAIN_LIMIT, then a run started_by account with its plan; stranger: queued with a receipt and a ceiling within one job's cap, the second press joins, then PUBLIC_AGAIN_LIMIT, then PUBLIC_RESEARCH_SPENT.
S6: the place gains the Instagram link verified by the operator; the unknown url is PAGE_NOT_FOUND.
S7: the field mask asks for formattedAddress, nationalPhoneNumber, internationalPhoneNumber and the facts keep them.
fence: researchAgainPlan + sourceDue({manual}), joinPlace({againPlan}) and the run's due() that never widens the plan, carryAttempts on a superseded one-part run, the per-account and per-place-day limits, matchSocialPage's nameNear/sameFullPhone/page_closed, socialQueries

tests: the plan names each part to run with its reason and price, and each part kept with its reason
a plan over a cap drops its dearest parts first and says so
a press runs a source our setup failed on an hour ago; the automatic rule still waits a day
match: a name one letter off with the branch phone → confirmed, marked name_near
match: two letters off, or a short word one letter off → rejected
match: a page that says it is closed is never confirmed
find: the first query finds nothing → the phone query finds the page
the search for each network leaves its own row on the published snapshot
a place researched before the search existed is searched by Research again, and nothing else runs
Research again with nothing due queues nothing
a Try again of one search that finds nothing new still records the try on the current research
a Research again pressed while a run is going joins it and queues nothing more
an account presses Research again on its place card: the run is its own, within its daily limit
a stranger on /find presses Research again: Tracy pays, once a place a day
/ops confirms a page the search left for a person to check, and the place gains it
facts carry the branch's own address and phone, what a found social page is matched on
